container.rtx-remix-renderer.copper_beac: Sets the color saturation of this beacon's lens and beam from grayscale to twice the dye's saturation.
Sets this placed beacon's beam and glowing lens brightness. Off disables both.
Sets the beam half-angle. 90 degrees illuminates a full forward hemisphere.
When enabled, the beam and head animation run only while the beacon receives redstone power.
Sets the axis's neutral angle. Animated bounds are offsets around this position.
Sets signed continuous rotation speed in degrees per second.
Sets the minimum animated offset from the neutral position.
Sets the maximum animated offset from the neutral position.
Sets the duration of one complete smooth oscillation.
Sets the time between deterministic smooth patrol targets.
rtxremix.settings.title: RTX Remix Settings
rtxremix.settings.reset.tip: Restore the settings on this page to their default values.
rtxremix.settings.reset.confirm.title: Reset %s Settings?
rtxremix.settings.reset.confirm.message: This resets every setting in %s. Continue?
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.tip: Restore every RTX Remix setting to its default value. Restart afterward to return post-processing controls to gameplay profiles.
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.confirm.title: Reset All RTX Remix Settings?
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.confirm.messa: This resets every RTX Remix setting. Restart afterward to return post-processing controls to gameplay profiles. Continue?
rtxremix.settings.openRemixMenu.tip: Opens the RTX Remix Graphics Settings menu. Minecraft ignores input while it is open. Close it with its own close button or Alt+X.
rtxremix.settings.blockLights.title: Block Lights
rtxremix.setting.dist.autoFade.tip: Match the Remix terrain fade band to Minecraft's render distance without overriding stronger situational profiles.
rtxremix.setting.dist.lod.tip: Path trace Distant Horizons' distant terrain beyond Minecraft's render distance. Needs Distant Horizons and Auto View Fade.
rtxremix.setting.dist.lodMemory.tip: How much mesh data Distant Horizons' terrain may hold for path tracing. When it is full the farthest LOD terrain gives way, so a higher Distant Horizons quality or render distance draws it less far. The GPU uses about twice this amount; lower it if video memory runs short. Unlimited sets no cap.
rtxremix.setting.dist.light.tip: Chunks beyond which block lights are culled. Auto follows Minecraft's render distance.
rtxremix.setting.dist.entity.tip: Chunks beyond which entities are not submitted. Auto uses Minecraft's view distance.
rtxremix.setting.light.reach.tip: Blocks from the camera at which a torch stops casting light. Brighter lights reach further and dimmer ones less. Lower values shrink the light list the path tracer samples from.
rtxremix.setting.framerate.unfocused.tip: Framerate cap while the game window is not focused. Lower values leave the GPU to other applications. Unlimited leaves only Minecraft's Max Framerate in force.
rtxremix.setting.sky.ambient.tip: Toggle the ambient area light derived from the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.haloFocus.tip: Controls how tightly atmospheric haze gathers around the sun and moon. Higher values create smaller, brighter halos; lower values spread a softer glow across more of the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.saturation.tip: Scales the colour of the sky, and how far the blue overhead that tone mapping bleaches is deepened back. Lower values wash it out, higher values deepen the blues and sunsets.
rtxremix.setting.sky.sunsetWarmth.tip: Warms the sky near the horizon toward the sun while it is low. Off keeps the physical sunset colours.
rtxremix.setting.sky.sunGlare.tip: Brightness of the glow close around the sun.
rtxremix.setting.sky.rainbow.tip: Brightness of the rainbow that shows opposite the sun as rain clears while the sun is low. Off disables rainbows.
rtxremix.setting.sky.starBrightness.tip: Brightness of the stars at night. 1.00 is the default.
rtxremix.setting.sky.aerialHaze.tip: How much distant land fades into the colour of the sky, most in low valleys and least on high ground. Off keeps distant land clear.
rtxremix.setting.lens.depthOfField.tip: How much what is nearer or farther than the block you look at blurs. Off keeps everything sharp; 1.00 is a light blur.
rtxremix.setting.lens.flare.tip: Strength of the ghosts bright lights leave across the lens, such as a held torch, of the starburst on the sun, and of the glow and streaks of the sun mirrored on water. Off removes them.
rtxremix.setting.lens.caustics.tip: Strength of the moving web of light that sunlit waves focus onto the floor of shallow water. Off removes it.
rtxremix.setting.sky.cirrusCoverage.tip: How much of the high sky thin, wispy cirrus streaks cover. Off removes them. Changes apply once the slider settles.
rtxremix.setting.sky.cirrusBrightness.ti: How bright the cirrus streaks are against the sky behind them.
rtxremix.setting.sky.aurora.tip: Shows curtains of aurora across the northern sky on clear nights.
rtxremix.setting.sky.auroraEverywhere.ti: Off shows the aurora only where it is cold enough to snow; on shows it everywhere.
rtxremix.setting.sky.minimumCelestialWea: Limits how much rain and thunder can hide the sun, moon, and stars. Time of day and horizon visibility are unchanged.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.style.tip: Classic voxelizes Minecraft's own clouds. Procedural draws soft, puffy clouds. Reimagined draws large rounded blocky clouds in thick layers. Unbound draws soft volumetric clouds that reach the horizon.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.coverage.tip: How much of the sky Reimagined and Unbound clouds cover. Unbound clouds also vary a little with the day and the weather. Reimagined changes apply once the slider settles.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.secondLayer.tip: Adds a higher layer of Reimagined clouds that drifts a little faster.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.speed.tip: How fast Reimagined and Unbound clouds drift. 1.00 matches Minecraft's clouds.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.unboundThickness: How tall Unbound clouds grow above their base, in blocks.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.unboundDensity.t: How thick Unbound clouds are inside. Higher values give darker bases and sharper edges.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.unboundBrightnes: How bright Unbound clouds are against the sky. 1.00 is the intended balance.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.unboundDetail.ti: How much fine noise breaks up the edges of Unbound clouds. Off gives smooth, rounded clouds.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.unboundRain.tip: How far rain thickens Unbound clouds toward an overcast sky.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.unboundShadow.ti: How dark the shadows Unbound clouds cast on the land are, drifting with the clouds. Off leaves the land unshaded.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.vanillaEdgeSmoot: Softens the edges of Minecraft's classic blocky clouds. Set this to zero for sharp, square edges.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.size.tip: Makes clouds larger or smaller. For Minecraft's classic clouds, this changes how thick they are.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.height.tip: Moves clouds higher or lower in the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.sunIntensity.tip: Controls the brightness of direct sunlight. 1.00 uses the intended balance.
rtxremix.setting.sky.moonIntensity.tip: Controls the brightness of moonlight. 1.00 uses the intended balance.
rtxremix.setting.sky.dayAmbient.tip: Controls the strength of soft light from the daytime sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.nightAmbient.tip: Controls the strength of soft light from the night sky.
Multiplies this block light's normal brightness. Off disables it; 1.00× keeps the intended brightness. Changes apply when you leave this screen.
rtxremix.setting.materials.terrainEmissi: Multiplies the light emitted by glowing block surfaces. Off disables their glow; 1.00× keeps the intended brightness. This does not change block lights such as torches.
rtxremix.setting.materials.smoothReliefM: Samples normal and height maps smoothly, which removes banding from surface bumps and depth, while block textures keep their pixelated look.
How much of open ground rain puddles cover. The ground around them grows wet and a little darker; the water stands in the deeper parts. Applies when you stop moving the slider.
rtxremix.setting.materials.puddleReflect: How strongly rain puddles reflect. Off reflects as clear water does, which barely shows on bright ground; higher values reflect more and darken the water a little, up to a mirror. Applies when you stop moving the slider.
rtxremix.setting.debug.puddleMask.tip: Paints rain puddles red, by how much water stands there, to show where they lie and how their edges fade. For finding problems only.
rtxremix.setting.debug.domeClouds.tip: Leaves the Unbound clouds as RTX Remix draws them on the sky dome, instead of drawing them again per pixel over the image, and draws no cloud shadows. Shows whether a flaw in the clouds comes from the per-pixel clouds. For finding problems only.
rtxremix.setting.post.exposure.tip: Makes the whole scene brighter or darker. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.shadows.tip: Controls how bright shaded areas appear. Raise it to reveal more detail in shadows. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.highlights.tip: Controls sunlight, emissive blocks, and other very bright areas. Raise it to darken intense highlights and preserve more detail. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.lowLightAdaptation: Helps you see in dark places. Lower values reveal more detail, but can make illuminated areas look pale or washed out. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.highLightAdaptatio: Helps your view adjust to very bright scenes so sunlight and emissive blocks remain comfortable and readable. Higher values tame harsh brightness, but can make daylight look dimmer. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
